definitions.A_pair: not used and not treated as identical to the thesis energy-fraction observable
definitions.normalization: inclusive and tertile panels normalized independently to unit sum; mean maps show raw mean H-like score; scatter contains every selected event
definitions.population: same canonical split/sample surface and fixed classifier scores as the preceding reco maps; truth pi-nu x pi-nu is independently reselected and is not intersected with reco final events
definitions.score: arithmetic mean of frozen full-reco seeds 42, 43, and 44 terminal checkpoints; eval-only inference; H-like score
definitions.tertiles: unit-weight score tertiles defined separately within each truth class and each population
definitions.truth_cos_theta: x=E_pi/E_tau; a=m_pi/m_tau; beta=sqrt(1-m_tau^2/E_tau^2); cos(theta)=(2x-1-a^2)/(beta*(1-a^2)); stored truth four-vector energies; nominal m_tau=1.77686 GeV and m_pi=0.13957039 GeV
definitions.truth_selection: clean boson tau pair; charge-ordered PDG 15 (tau-) and -15 (tau+); each tau mode code 0 with exactly one generator-level charged pion and one tau neutrino and no other preserved decay objects; pi+nu four-vector closure <=1e-4
